001: So, for this new campaign, are we putting everything into social media?
I think we especially need to target young adults; they are very present on these platforms.
Yes, but our brand also has an older clientele, we can't neglect them.
That's true. We could maybe combine a digital campaign with billboards in big cities.
Good idea. And for the message, do we focus more on quality or on price?
I'd say on quality, because that's what really sets us apart from our competitors.
002: Have you seen the latest traffic numbers for our website?
Yes, they've been going down for two months, it's quite worrying.
I wonder if our content is still relevant for our audience.
Maybe we should carry out a market study to better understand their expectations.
That's a good lead. We could also analyze what our competitors are doing.
Absolutely. I'm going to prepare a detailed report with all this data.
003: The launch of the new product is planned in three weeks, is everything ready?
Almost. We still need to finalize the press release.
And for the influencers, have we confirmed their participation?
Yes, most of them responded favorably, they're very enthusiastic.
Perfect. I hope this collaboration will bring us great visibility.
Me too. With their help, we should reach a much wider audience.
004: I think our logo is starting to look dated, maybe we should modernize it.
That's a possibility, but it's also a risk of losing our brand image.
You're right, customers are very attached to it. We could just refresh it slightly.
Yes, a subtle redesign would be safer. I'll contact a design agency.
And for the slogan, do you think it's still effective?
It's still well remembered by the public, I wouldn't change it for now.
005: Our television advertising campaign worked well, sales have increased.
That's excellent news. Maybe we should extend its run.
Yes, but that represents a significant budget. We need to check our margin.
I understand. Maybe we could negotiate a better rate with the channel.
Good idea. And in parallel, we could step up our presence on social media.
Absolutely, that's a much less expensive and very effective channel.
006: I received the results of the satisfaction survey, they're rather positive.
Oh, that's great! What do customers appreciate the most about us?
They especially highlight the quality of our after-sales service.
That's a real strength we absolutely need to highlight in our communication.
I agree. We could make it the central theme of our next campaign.
Excellent idea. That will strengthen our brand image with consumers.
007: How did the meeting with the advertising agency go?
Very well. They presented us with several very interesting creative concepts.
Is there one that stands out particularly?
Yes, a concept focused on authenticity and artisanal know-how.
That matches our values well. Maybe we could develop it further.
I completely agree. I'll ask them to prepare a more detailed version for us.
008: The marketing budget has been reduced for the next quarter.
That's annoying. We're going to have to review our priorities and our strategies.
Maybe we could focus on digital marketing, which is cheaper.
Yes, and it's also where we get the best return on investment.
And for events, we could favor smaller, more targeted formats.
That's a smart approach. That way we can maintain our presence without going over budget.
009: Have you thought about the monthly newsletter for our loyal customers?
Yes, I prepared a first draft. I wanted to get your opinion on it.
Of course, I'll read it. Maybe we should add a promotional code to it.
That's a good idea to encourage them to come back to us. I'll add it.
And do you think we should also include an article about our new line?
Absolutely, that will spark their curiosity and encourage them to discover our products.
010: Our presence at the trade show was very fruitful, we got a lot of contacts.
That's excellent news. Have you already sorted through the most promising leads?
Not yet, but I plan to get started on it tomorrow morning.
Perfect. We should also send a thank-you email to all the visitors to our booth.
Yes, it's important to maintain the connection. And we could offer them a free demonstration.
Excellent initiative. That could well turn them into potential customers.
